subject: Eval ClearPath — success criteria, timeline, and owner assignments
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@clearpath.ai>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Eval ClearPath — success criteria, timeline, and owner assignments

Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion and really excited about the potential fit. Below is a concise post-call recap + proposed trial plan so we have clear owners and fast momentum. Please reply with edits or confirmations by EOD Wednesday.

Quick recap (from today's discovery):
- Goal: Reduce customer support deflection for ticket triage by 40% on sample datasets (English + Spanish).
- Primary success metric: 40% reduction in time-to-first-response on the triage queue for the test cohort; secondary metric: model precision @ top1 >= 82%.
- Tech constraints: on-prem data cannot leave VPC; security questionnaire in flight; expected data availability: sample export + anonymized ticket subset (approx 15k messages) by Jan 21.

Proposed 4-week Proof-of-Value (PoV) plan:
1) Week 0 (this week) — Setup & onboarding
   - Deliverables: NDA + simple SOW (Priya) ; security questionnaire (Customer) ; data export access (Customer)
   - Owners: Priya (commercial), Aditya (technical), Claire to provide export
2) Week 1 — Integration & baseline run
   - Deliverables: Redwood test instance, sample ingestion, baseline metrics run
   - Owners: Aditya (integration), ClearPath eng (data mapping)
3) Week 2 — Model tuning & evaluation
   - Deliverables: 2 model variants, eval scripts, acceptance test plan
   - Owners: Aditya + Monica (validation)
4) Week 3 — Readout & decision
   - Deliverables: Readout deck, recommendation, topline ROI estimate, next-step contract draft
   - Owners: Priya + Ben (commercial)

Immediate asks / next steps (please confirm):
- Claire / Samir: Confirm data export availability and who on your side will own secure transfer by COB Jan 21.
- Procurement: Can you share high-level procurement timeline (contract review window)?
- Aditya: Can you confirm ETA for integration checklist and whether an on-site VPN or secure S3 transfer is preferred?
- Monica: We'll need a short eval rubric — I can draft, want you to own validation run.

Attachments: POV-Success-Criteria.xlsx (proposal), SOW-draft-v1.pdf (placeholder)

Thanks — if everyone can hit the confirm asks above, we'll lock calendar for the Week 0 kickoff.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Samir Gupta <samir@clearpath.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearpath.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval ClearPath — success criteria, timeline, and owner assignments

Thanks Priya — this aligns with our expectations. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Data: We can produce the anonymized ticket subset by Jan 20 (Claire will share the export instructions today).
- Security: attaching a short list of additional security checks we'll need (security-questions.pdf). Can your security team confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS + on-prem connector?
- Acceptance: In addition to the 40% reduction metric, we also need the model to avoid false positives on escalation triage; suggest adding a constraint: false positive escalation rate <= 5%.

Procurement note: Our legal is on vacation until Jan 25, so contract review likely starts the week of Jan 25. Procurement has asked if we can run the PoV under a simple MSA + trial exhibit to speed the start. Procurement cc'd: procure@clearpath.ai

Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Data & AI | ClearPath AI
samir@clearpath.ai
+1 212-555-4472

Attachments: security-questions.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@clearpath.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval ClearPath — success criteria, timeline, and owner assignments

Appreciate the details — a few technical confirmations and the integration plan.
- Data transfer: Secure S3 presigned uploads are easiest for your team. If ClearPath requires VPC-restricted transfer, we can spin up an on-prem connector; that will add ~2 business days. Please indicate preference.
- Test dataset needs: sample export + a mapping file (ticket_id -> anonymized_user_id) and a small schema doc. Target: ingest 15k rows, validate schema by Jan 22.
- Integration checklist: I'm sharing an internal checklist (integration-checklist.md) with the exact infra steps and estimated effort. I can finalize and share by close of day Jan 20.
- Eval harness: I'll prepare a validation notebook and evaluation script to compute the metrics (time-to-first-response simulation + precision/recall).

I'll own the technical setup and initial baseline run. If procurement needs any IP terms for a trial exhibit, loop in Priya and Ben.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

Attachments: integration-checklist.md

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@clearpath.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval ClearPath — success criteria, timeline, and owner assignments

Adding a couple operational items from CS perspective:
- Weekly sync cadence: propose Tuesdays 10am PT for 30min standups from Jan 26 — will keep short and focused (status, blockers, owners).
- Validation owner: I'll own the acceptance run and produce the readout deck in Week 3; would like ClearPath to identify a product/ops person to validate labeling assumptions.
- Acceptance rubric: I'll draft a one-page rubric and share in the shared Drive link below. Please review and comment ahead of the Week 1 baseline run.

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bClearPathShared

Monica Patel

monica@redwood.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@clearpath.ai>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, procure@clearpath.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Eval ClearPath — success criteria, timeline, and owner assignments (weekly status)

Quick weekly nudge — keeping momentum and confirming a few dates/owners: 
- Data export: Claire confirmed offline — export expected Jan 20 (received). Thank you.
- Technical setup: Aditya to complete integration checklist and share test instance details by Jan 22 — action in progress.
- Security: Redwood security team acknowledges the KMS + on-prem questions; Aditya to share the connector options in his checklist.
- Procurement: Samir noted legal availability Jan 25; Priya + Ben will prepare a trial exhibit to attach to the MSA so procurement can review faster.
- CS validation: Monica will own acceptance and share rubric by Jan 24 (draft in Drive).

Call to action: If any of the owners above cannot meet the dates, please reply here with alternative ETA. Otherwise, I’ll lock the Tue Jan 26 weekly sync 10am PT and send calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to a clean kickoff.

Best,
Priya
